title: Audit-failure procedure under Policy 463 — follow-up to W012666 item 8
summary:
Follow-up to W012666-050426 item 8, which asked for the framework governing accountability when an audit duty is not performed. SMPD closed item 8 by directing the requester to the Department's "Policy and Oversight" webpage without identifying a specific policy section.

This request asks SMPD to identify, by number and title, the specific Policy 463 or SOP section(s) addressing:

1. the Department's procedure when a required Policy 463 audit is not performed within the timeframe the policy specifies; and
2. the Department's procedure when a required Policy 463 audit is performed but later determined to have omitted required scope (e.g., a category of access or sharing that should have been reviewed but was not).

If no written policy or SOP addresses either category, the request asks SMPD to confirm that in its response.

policy_promises.quote: an audit is conducted of ALPR data searches at least monthly for internal ALPR users and quarterly for external CA public agency users
policy_promises.tests: What written procedure governs the Department's response when these audits are not performed on time, or are performed but miss required scope?

prior_pra_refs.note: Parent PRA item 8 asked for the framework governing accountability for non-performance of audit duties. SMPD answered with a link to the Policy and Oversight webpage, which does not identify a specific responsive section.

filed_because: SMPD's response to W012666 item 8 pointed at a general webpage rather than naming a policy section. This request forces SMPD to either identify the specific section by number and title or confirm on the record that no such written procedure exists.
notes: Closed 2026-06-04: 'A good faith and diligent search yielded no records responsive to your request.' SMPD again directed the requester to the Policy and Oversight webpage and Policy 340 (Standards of Conduct), identifying no Policy 463 or SOP section. The no-records answer confirms on the record that no written SMPD policy or SOP governs (1) a required Policy 463 audit not performed on time, or (2) an audit performed but later found to have omitted required scope.
